reasonThisRecordExists.statement: The session that recorded the F0I owner freeze approval had itself begun after a /clear, so no prior-turn 'complete prepared owner freeze statement' text was present in that session's context to reproduce verbatim. The existing approval record therefore stored the literal, shorter confirmation message actually received (marker 'APPROVE_F0I_FREEZE' plus the specific hashes/commits it named) together with an explicit honesty note (its own 'ownerStatementReceptionNote' field) disclosing exactly that gap. This record closes that gap additively: it restates, from the F0I freeze bytes and the existing approval record themselves - never from memory, never re-typed from the owner's later instruction - every value the complete prepared owner statement would have named, so the approval chain is self-contained without needing the missing earlier-session text.
